posts.text: ‘We are seeing some real dysfunction': Trump's foreign policy under scrutiny ahead of midterms — Trump’s foreign policy is on the ballot this year: from siding with Putin, to annexing Greenland, to threatening Canada and starting a war with Iran. Retired Lt General and MS NOW military analyst Mark Hertling joins “The Weekend” to dig into Trump’s foreign policy record and whether it’s lived up to his America first promises.

Iran in ‘Advanced Stages’ of Planning Attacks Against Americans, Officials Say — The U.S. government has ordered diplomats and other federal employees to leave Saudi Arabia. It is also drawing down staff at other missions in the region.
Iran says won’t allow US warships to get close as Trump ponders new attacks — Iranian officials, media and analysts sense war is closer, but signal there will be no backing down.

Attention, Passengers: High Airfares May Be Here to Stay — Ticket prices jumped after fuel costs spiked because of the war with Iran, but airlines say even an end to the conflict will not bring fares back down quickly.
Is Iran planning attacks on Americans; why is the US on alert? — US intelligence memo warns that Iranian plots against US citizens in the Middle East 'have reached advanced stages'.

U.S. is reducing staffing at 4 Middle East embassies over increased threats from Iran — In a memo sent Friday to Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said his teams "have received intelligence that Iran has substantially increased efforts to target U.S. personnel."

Iran has 'substantially increased' efforts to target Americans abroad, US intelligence memo warns — An intelligence memo sent to Marco Rubio reveals Iranian plots to kill Americans have reached advanced stages in the Middle East and other countries.

Drinking water supplies dwindle in Yemeni city besieged by Houthi rebels — Taiz, a city in southwestern Yemen, faces a severe water crisis as Houthi rebels backed by Iran tighten their encirclement. The city has struggled with water issues for over a decade, but the situation has worsened in recent weeks.

SEAL Team 6 Operator Recounts The Full Mission That Led To Osama Bin Laden's Death — Watch the full conversation here: Watch more here: #TuckerCarlson #RobONeill #OsamabinLaden #war #Iran #Iraq #SEALTeam6 #military #demons #DonaldTrump #BarackObama #GeorgeBush #news
Global Oil Price Hits $116 a Barrel, Highest Since April — Investors have grown increasingly concerned that the war in Iran could escalate again, putting energy supplies at greater risk.

Rubio urges Cubans to work with CIA to bring political change to communist-run island — Secretary of State Marco Rubio urged Cubans to form a "discrete partnership with the CIA" as Trump floated sending him to Cuba to cut a deal.

WATCH: Trump at GOP rally in Florida revives idea of military intervention in Cuba after Iran — President Donald Trump on Friday told a rally for candidates in South Florida that U.S. warships returning from the Middle East could stop over in Cuba on their way back from the Iran war, his latest suggestion of taking an interventionist approach to the nearby country.

Niall Ferguson: The Method to Trump’s Foreign Policy Madness — To understand Trump’s approach to Ukraine, Iran, and China, look to Richard Nixon. The president’s instinct for superpower dealmaking reflects a hard-nosed realism, backed by the American economy, writes Niall Ferguson.
The Epstein Files Produce an Unlikely Weapon for the Houthi Messaging Wars — The Yemeni militia is using the culture of its sworn enemies in the renewed fighting with Saudi Arabia.

43 years after Beirut terror attack killed 241 Americans, rabbi recalls chaplains’ extraordinary response — On the 43rd anniversary of the Beirut barracks terror attack that killed 241 Americans, a rabbi recalls how he and two Christian chaplains rushed to aid the wounded and comfort the survivors.

Military reinforcements move to Mideast. And, millions of Americans vote early — Military reinforcements are heading to the Middle East and some personnel have left the region, pointing to a potential attack on Iran. And, millions of Americans have already voted in the midterms.
